editorial.name: Roller Disco
editorial.description: A vertical rainbow-striped romper, bright knee socks, and a pink sweatband bring the roller-rink party.
editorial.alt: Rainbow-striped short romper with rainbow knee socks, hot pink sweatband and wristbands, and white sneakers.
editorial.tip: Wear your own comfortable sneakers. Skates are optional and are not included. The rompers are made to order, so check timing before buying.

editorial.name: Pop Art Comic
editorial.description: A black jumpsuit becomes a living comic panel with painted dots, bold outlines, and a homemade speech bubble.
editorial.alt: Black jumpsuit and ankle boots with primary-color comic face dots and a handmade speech-bubble badge.
editorial.tip: Paint dots and bold outlines with face paint. Make a speech bubble from your own card and pin it to the outfit. The badge is DIY, not included.

editorial.name: Mad Tea Hatter
editorial.description: A tall tagged hat, midnight brocade coat, ivory ruffles, and plum trousers make a gloriously mismatched tea-party host.
editorial.alt: Black top hat with a 10/6 card, midnight-blue brocade long coat, ivory ruffled shirt, plum trousers, and black boots.
pieces: Tall hat with a DIY 10/6 card
Fitted plum or burgundy velvet trousers
editorial.tip: Tuck a handwritten 10/6 card into your hat band. Carry a cup you already own. The card, ribbon, and cup are styling additions, not included.

editorial.name: Queen of Hearts
editorial.description: A dramatic red-and-black card gown and sculpted red wig turn every doorway into a royal entrance.
editorial.alt: Queen of Hearts in a red and black heart-motif gown, a red heart-shaped wig, small crown, and black boots.
pieces: Queen of Hearts dress or gown set
editorial.tip: Let the gown and wig make the statement. Crown contents vary by dress option. Compare the merchant photos and costume size chart before choosing.

editorial.name: Candy Automaton
editorial.description: Candy-shop stripes, red velvet, silver gloves, and a homemade wind-up key turn you into a clockwork confection.
editorial.alt: Red velvet short romper with black and white striped hips, silver gloves, black boots, and a homemade silver wind-up key on the back.
editorial.tip: Cut a large wind-up key from your own light cardboard and cover it with kitchen foil. Attach it to a soft belt. The key is DIY, not included.

evidence.description: Aquacolor is a glycerin-based compact make-up, especially color-intensive, with the ingredients of superior-quality skin cream preparations. Aquacolor is universally applicable, primarily as a make-up for face and body painting. Application is effortless, with an only slightly moistened make-up sponge or brush. After drying, it can be gently buffed with a soft towel or with the hand - but is not powdered. Setting Spray is recommended if the make-up will be subjected to extreme conditions. Aquacolor is extensively smudge-proof and can be easily removed with soap and water. Aquacolor is available in an extensive variety of colors, which include skin and vivid shades
evidence.notes: Selected 6 Colors - A palette. Water-activated face/body paint; brushes are not included in the stated contents. Confirm the pictured colors before purchase.

evidence.description: Introducing the Studio Color - Carnival Studio, the ultimate makeup palette for endless creativity. With 8 refillable colors, this versatile studio is perfect for on-the-go touch-ups or bold looks. Unleash your inner artist with the Carnival Studio. The Carnival Creme Palette contains a spectrum of vivid creme colors for creating beautiful and creative works of all kinds. Each shade is vibrant and intensely pigmented to give you total control in achieving your makeup design. The colors easily blend together to create new shades or exquisite contours. With all aspects of the color wheel in one convenient palette, artists and students of all skill levels are able to explore their full creative potential. This palette is ideal for theatrical, fashion, drag, Halloween enthusiasts, students, and cosplay makeup artists. Expect 20-50 applications per shade.
evidence.notes: Eight vivid creme colors. This is makeup, not a printed garment. Brushes and setting products are not included in the stated contents.

evidence.description: Highly pigmented, water activated professional face and body makeup enriched with vitamins and skin soothin ingredients. Remove with Mehron's Makeup Remover. Shades of red, yellow and orange are not recommended for use around the eyes nor blue or green around the lips.
evidence.notes: Water-activated professional face/body makeup. Follow merchant application guidance: red/yellow/orange are not recommended around eyes; blue/green are not recommended around lips.
